propositions: The macOS pytest job (18.6m) is the critical path of the Gerrit Verified gate (21-47m); coverage.py tracing consumes 15.4m of this duration but no consumer uses the macOS coverage result.
Coverage floor enforcement (fail_under=70) is redundantly applied three times on ubuntu cells running the identical test selection; macOS coverage collection is pure duplicate work.

Conditional coverage flags by OS matrix eliminate macOS tracing overhead (~0.8m gain) while preserving identical test selection (7856 tests) and ubuntu-enforced coverage floor, with no platform-compat coverage loss.
The workflow change must preserve the substring pytest -m 'not integration and not external' identically across platforms and pass test_ci_workflow_parity.py.
Empty-string branches in GitHub Actions ternaries must occupy the || (right) slot to avoid silent no-ops where empty strings evaluate falsy on both branches.
